replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived promoter state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in Drosophila promoters (n = 5912 promoters).
Promoters were first binned based on their log2 Pol II ChIP-seq signal. Within each bin, the median frequency of each of the promoter state was calculated.
outputs.explanation: The panel reports both the number of promoters (n = 5912) underlying the binned median-frequency distribution and the type of unit (promoters).

replicate_statements: Single-locus example showing single-molecule sorting of a highly active, TATA-box containing Drosophila promoter (Svil, 94th percentile by Pol II ChIP-seq).
The percentages of molecules harbouring footprints for the engaged Pol II and PIC are indicated on the right side of the plot.
outputs.replicate_type: single DNA molecules (2952 molecules shown in the stack)
outputs.explanation: The panel image states the number of molecules (2952) used to derive the single-molecule stack and state-frequency percentages, and the type of unit (single DNA molecules) is clear from the panel and caption.

replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in mouse promoters (n = 6122 promoters).
outputs.explanation: The panel reports both the number of promoters (n = 6122) and the type of unit (promoters), analogous to panel A.

replicate_statements: Single-locus example of a single-molecule sorting of a highly active, TATA-box containing mouse promoter (Skp1, 97th percentile by Pol II ChIP-seq).
outputs.replicate_type: single DNA molecules (2871 molecules shown in the stack)
outputs.explanation: The panel image states the number of molecules (2871) and the type of unit (single DNA molecules), consistent with panel B.

replicate_statements: Comparison of PIC state frequency between mouse (TATA-less n = 572 promoters; TATA-containing n = 64 promoters) and Drosophila (TATA-less n = 422 promoters; TATA-containing n = 71 promoters) promoters.
Boxplots represent the distribution of the frequency of PIC-bound molecules (PIC and PIC + Pol II states) at highly active promoters (top 5% Pol II ChIP-seq level).
outputs.explanation: Sample sizes are given explicitly for each of the four boxplot groups (n = 572, 64, 422, 71 promoters), and the unit type (promoters) is stated; all group sizes exceed 2.
